meta.title: Custom software development and SaaS products
meta.description: Development studio in Spain. Custom websites, web and mobile apps, integrations, AI agents and turnkey Bitrix24, plus our own SaaS products by subscription.

hero.lead: We build custom software for businesses and run our own SaaS products. One team takes you from idea to launch and support.

services.title: Custom development
services.lead: A whole project or just the missing piece. We use the same stack our own products run on.

web.title: Websites and landing pages
web.text: Fast multilingual sites with technical SEO, a content panel and forms that go straight into your CRM.

apps.title: Web apps and SaaS
apps.text: Dashboards, client areas, custom CRMs and multi-tenant SaaS products, from prototype to production.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.text: One codebase for iOS and Android: sign-in, payments, notifications and store publishing.

bitrix.title: Turnkey Bitrix24
bitrix.text: Full setup: pipelines, fields, automations, telephony, reports and team training. Custom apps for your portal.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.text: We connect CRM, website, telephony, payments, accounting and messengers so nobody copies data by hand.

ai.title: AI agents
ai.text: Assistants that read the CRM, summarise calls, fill in reports and answer clients, wired into Bitrix24 and your systems.

aiAdoption.title: AI in your processes
aiAdoption.text: We find where AI saves your team time, connect it to your processes and systems, and train people to use it.

devops.title: Infrastructure and support
devops.text: Servers, automatic deployment, backups and monitoring. We stay with you after launch.

products.title: Our own products
products.lead: We build and maintain our own software. What we offer clients, we use every day.

inkspace.name: Ink Space
inkspace.text: CRM and booking for tattoo studios: appointments, clients, consent forms and a client area.

plisplas.name: Plis Plas
plisplas.text: CRM for beauty and nail salons: bookings, client history and staff.

bitrix.name: Sales automation
bitrix.text: Bitrix24 apps that guide active B2B sales: one report after each call, automatic pipeline and tasks, team KPIs. Running on many portals at once.

process.title: How we work
process.lead: No surprises: scope and price in writing, visible progress every week.

talk.title: Conversation
talk.text: You tell us the task; we ask questions and look at what you already have. Free, no commitment.

offer.title: Proposal
offer.text: Scope, timeline and price in writing. Big projects go in stages with a delivery every one or two weeks.

build.title: Development
build.text: You see progress on a staging environment from the first week. The code and the accounts are yours.

launch.title: Launch and support
launch.text: We go live, train the team and carry on with maintenance and improvements.

about.title: Software for clients, and software of our own
about.text: IT-firma is the studio of {name}, a full-stack software engineer in Spain. We work in two lines: custom software for clients, and our own SaaS products offered by subscription. Each feeds the other: what we recommend to a client, we have launched and maintain ourselves.

own.title: Our own SaaS
own.text: We build and run cloud services for small businesses, paid by subscription. We know what a product costs after launch.

clean.title: Maintainable code
clean.text: Strict TypeScript, clean architecture, tests and CI. Another team can pick up where we left off.

direct.title: Direct contact
direct.text: You talk to the person who designs and writes the code, with no middlemen.

spain.title: In Spain, for Europe
spain.text: We invoice from Spain, apply GDPR by design and work remotely across Europe.

contact.title: Tell us about your project
contact.lead: We reply within one working day with questions or a first estimate.
contact.note: Prefer to write directly? Use the e-mail. Form data is only used to reply to you.
